content.lb_assessment: Both LightGBM and XGBoost models with the external EV adoption dataset achieve CV scores around 0.942, while our best public score is 0.94558, just 0.00082 below the top‑20% threshold (0.9464). No blend has been tried yet, and blending diverse models has historically provided the largest gains. The current plan’s later steps (increasing num_leaves, treating numeric columns as categorical) are lower‑leverage than a blend at this point.
